title: Poison
html:
For other possible meanings of Poison in the game, see:  Poison (disambiguation)

⁠Poison is one of the damage types in the game.

  • For all sources of Poison, see Category:Sources of Poison damage.
  • For creatures weak to Poison, see Category:Vulnerable to Poison.
  • For creatures resistant to Poison, see Category:Resistant to Poison.
  • For creatures immune to Poison, see Category:Immune to Poison.

Sources of Poison damage

The following sections list various ways in which a player character, or creatures they summon, can deal Poison damage.

Special actions, spells, etc. that are exclusively accessible to non-player characters are not listed.

Spells

  •  Chromatic Orb: Poison
  •  Cloudkill
  •  Ethel's Ray of Sickness
  •  Poison Spray
  •  Ray of Sickness

Class actions

  •  Arcane Shot: Grasping Arrow
  •  Sphere of Elemental Balance: Poison

Special actions

  •  Bibberbang Spores
  •  Bite (Spider)
  •  Divine Strike: Poison
  •  Divine Strike: Poison (Melee)
  •  Divine Strike: Poison (Ranged)
  •  Healing Vapours
  •  Poison Breath
  •  Poison Mist
  •  Sting (Imp)
  •  Timmask Spores (class action)
  •  Venomous Discharge (Addled Frog)
  •  Venomous Discharge (Phase Spider Matriarch)
  •  Venomous Discharge (Phase Spider)

Weapons

The following weapons deal Poison damage as part of their regular attacks.

  •  Djinni Scimitar - inaccessible
  •  Handmaiden's Mace
  •  Hellbeard Halberd
  •  Infernal Mace
  •  Infernal Mace (Uncommon)
  •  Infernal Spear
  •  Infernal Warhammer - inaccessible

Equipment

The following equipment add Poison damage to the wearer's attacks or can deal Poison damage through other means.

  •  Broodmother's Revenge: Whenever healed, gain  Venomous Revenge for 2 turns, gaining +1d6⁠⁠Poison.
  •  Poisoner's Robe: When dealing poison damage with a spell, deal +1d4⁠⁠Poison.
  •  Thorn Blade: While concentrating, your melee weapon attacks deal an additional +1d4⁠⁠Poison.

Consumables

The following consumable items can be used to deal Poison damage. In the case of arrows, the damage is in addition to the attacker's regular ranged weapon damage.

See coatings for details on the general mechanics of toxins.

  •  Simple Toxin: Applies  Simple Toxin dealing 1d4⁠⁠Poison.
  •  Serpent Fang Toxin: Applies  Serpent Fang Toxin dealing 1d6⁠⁠Poison.
  •  Wyvern Toxin: Applies  Wyvern Toxin dealing 1d8⁠⁠Poison.
  •  Purple Worm Toxin: Applies  Purple Worm Toxin dealing 1d10⁠⁠Poison.
  •  Thisobald's Brewed-Up Bellyglummer: Applies  Brewed-Up Bellyglummer dealing 1d6⁠⁠Poison.
  •  Fungal Bamboozler,  Noxious Spore Grenade,  Merregon Potion: Deal 2d4+1⁠⁠Poison in an area on a successful attack roll.
  •  Poisonous Slime Bomb: Deal 1d4+1⁠⁠Poison in an area.
  •  Suspicious Poison: Deals 3d6⁠⁠Poison repeatedly. Disguised as a potion, but can be thrown to affect an area.

Interactions

  •  Poisoner's Gloves: When dealing poison damage, target may become  Poisoned.
  •  Poisoner's Ring: Can make a target vulnerable to poison via  Virulent Venom.
  •  Ring of Poison Resistance: Gain resistance to poison.
  •  Protection from Poison: Gain resistance to poison.
  •  Nature's Step: Gain resistance to poison.

Notes

  • Poison damage normally has nothing to do with the  Poisoned condition.
